description: Write documentation first, code second, for any non-trivial change to a codebase. Use when starting a new feature, refactor, bug fix, or migration; when multi-file work needs a reviewable plan; or right after a discuss-before-begin session has reached consensus. Keeps decisions, plans and the "why"
